name: Comet
description: Comet is a browser automation and web data extraction platform that uses AI to navigate websites, interact with web pages, and extract structured data — functioning as an AI-powered web scraping and automation agent.

writing-chat.summary: Comet provides a conversational interface for describing web automation tasks in natural language, which the agent then executes autonomously in a browser environment.

subFeatures.name: Natural Language Task Description
subFeatures.description: Describe web automation tasks in plain English — Comet translates instructions into browser actions and executes them

subFeatures.name: Task Status and Results
subFeatures.description: View real-time progress of browser automation tasks with step-by-step action logs and final results

limitations: Chat is task-oriented, not general-purpose conversation
Cannot discuss topics outside web automation scope
Limited to web browser task instructions
No creative writing or general Q&A capabilities

pricingTiers.details: Limited number of automation tasks per month
Higher task limits with priority execution
Custom limits, dedicated support, API access

research.summary: Comet excels at web-based research by automatically navigating websites, extracting data from multiple pages, and compiling structured results — making it effective for competitive research, price monitoring, and data collection.

subFeatures.name: Multi-Page Data Extraction
subFeatures.description: Automatically navigate through multiple web pages, extracting and structuring data from search results, listings, and directories

subFeatures.name: Competitive Research Automation
subFeatures.description: Monitor competitor websites, extract pricing, product details, and feature comparisons across multiple sources

subFeatures.name: Structured Data Output
subFeatures.description: Export extracted web data as structured JSON, CSV, or spreadsheet formats for analysis

limitations: Cannot access login-protected content without credentials
Rate-limited by target website defenses and robots.txt compliance
Research limited to publicly accessible web content
May be blocked by aggressive anti-bot measures

pricingTiers.details: Limited research extractions per month
Higher extraction limits and priority processing
Custom extraction limits and dedicated infrastructure

versionHistory.changes: Web data extraction and research automation

file-analysis.summary: Comet is focused on web browser automation and does not provide file upload or analysis capabilities.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Comet operates in web browsers — it does not accept file uploads or analyze local files

limitations: No file upload capability
Cannot analyze local documents, images, or code files
Limited to web page content analysis

pricingTiers.details: Not available

document-creation.summary: Comet creates structured data outputs from web extraction tasks — CSV files, JSON exports, and spreadsheets containing extracted web data, though it does not generate prose documents.

subFeatures.name: Data Export
subFeatures.description: Export extracted web data as CSV, JSON, or structured spreadsheet files for further analysis or import into other tools

subFeatures.name: Extraction Reports
subFeatures.description: Generate summary reports of extraction tasks including data quality metrics and extraction statistics

limitations: Limited to structured data output — no prose document generation
Cannot create presentations, PDFs, or formatted reports
Output format options limited to data-oriented formats
No document editing or collaboration features

pricingTiers.details: Basic data export formats
Full export format options and larger data exports

versionHistory.changes: CSV, JSON, and spreadsheet data export

image-generation.summary: Comet does not generate images. It is a web automation and data extraction tool.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Comet is focused on browser automation — image generation is not part of its feature set

limitations: No image generation capability
No visual asset creation
Tool is designed for web data extraction, not content creation

pricingTiers.details: Not available

prototyping.summary: Comet does not provide code generation or software prototyping capabilities. It is focused on web browser automation for data extraction.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Comet automates web browser tasks — it does not generate code or assist with software prototyping

limitations: No code generation or execution
No IDE integration
Not designed for software development workflows
Cannot prototype applications or generate source code

pricingTiers.details: Not available

personalization.summary: Comet allows users to save and customize automation workflows, creating reusable templates for repeated data extraction tasks.

subFeatures.name: Saved Workflows
subFeatures.description: Save configured automation tasks as reusable workflows that can be re-run with different parameters

subFeatures.name: Custom Extraction Schemas
subFeatures.description: Define custom data schemas that specify exactly what fields to extract from web pages

limitations: Personalization limited to task configuration
No general-purpose preference system
No memory of conversational preferences
Customization focused on automation workflows only

pricingTiers.details: Limited saved workflows
Unlimited saved workflows and custom schemas

versionHistory.changes: Saved workflow templates and custom extraction schemas

persistent-context.summary: Comet maintains a history of extraction tasks and their results, with saved workflows serving as persistent automation templates.

subFeatures.name: Task History
subFeatures.description: Complete history of all executed automation tasks with results, timestamps, and configuration details

subFeatures.name: Workflow Templates
subFeatures.description: Persistent workflow configurations that retain extraction logic across sessions for repeated use

limitations: No conversational memory across tasks
Context limited to automation task configuration
No knowledge base or document storage
History focused on extraction results, not general context

pricingTiers.details: Limited task history retention
Extended task history and persistent workflows

agents.summary: Comet is fundamentally an AI agent — it autonomously navigates web browsers, fills forms, clicks buttons, scrolls pages, and extracts data without human intervention after receiving task instructions.

subFeatures.name: Autonomous Browser Agent
subFeatures.description: AI agent that independently controls a web browser to navigate pages, interact with elements, and complete multi-step web tasks

subFeatures.name: Multi-Step Task Execution
subFeatures.description: Execute complex workflows involving navigation across multiple pages, form filling, pagination, and conditional logic

subFeatures.name: Visual Page Understanding
subFeatures.description: Understand web page layouts visually to identify interactive elements, data tables, and content areas for extraction

limitations: Agent limited to web browser actions only
Cannot perform desktop automation or file system operations
May fail on heavily JavaScript-dependent or dynamically loaded pages
CAPTCHA and anti-bot measures can block agent execution

pricingTiers.details: Limited agent task executions per month
Higher execution limits with priority processing
Custom limits, parallel execution, dedicated browser instances

versionHistory.changes: AI-powered autonomous browser agent for web automation

connectors.summary: Comet connects to the web through its browser automation engine and can export data to various formats and integrations.

subFeatures.name: Web Browser Engine
subFeatures.description: Headless browser engine that can access any public website, handling JavaScript rendering, cookies, and session management

subFeatures.name: Data Export Integrations
subFeatures.description: Export extracted data to spreadsheets, databases, and other tools via CSV, JSON, and API webhooks

limitations: No native integrations with Slack, Notion, or productivity tools
No Google Drive or cloud storage direct connectors
Webhook integrations require technical setup
Browser automation subject to website terms of service

pricingTiers.details: Basic browser automation and CSV export
Full export options and webhook integrations
Custom integrations and API access

versionHistory.changes: Browser automation engine and data export connectors

dictation.summary: Comet does not include voice input or dictation capabilities. All interaction is through text-based task descriptions.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Comet is a web automation tool with text-based input only — no voice or speech capabilities

limitations: No voice input or dictation
No speech-to-text capabilities
Text-only task description interface

pricingTiers.details: Not available
